open.name: Open
open.description: Controls whether the dialog is open.

identifier.name: Identifier
identifier.description: The identifier of the item to be deleted.

type.name: Type
type.description: The type of the item being deleted, used in the description message.

isLoading.name: Is Loading
isLoading.description: Shows a loading state on the confirm button.

withForm.name: With Form
withForm.description: Requires the user to type a keyword to confirm deletion.

deletionItemName.name: Deletion Item Name
deletionItemName.description: Display name of the item being deleted.

deletionKeyword.name: Deletion Keyword
deletionKeyword.description: The keyword the user must type to confirm deletion when withForm is true.

deleteConfirmText.name: Delete Confirm Text
deleteConfirmText.description: Custom label for the confirm button.

violation.name: Violation
violation.description: Indicates a rule violation exists for the deletion.

bypassable.name: Bypassable
bypassable.description: Whether the violation can be bypassed to proceed with deletion.
